"'''Dune Sea Special'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] written some time before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> It was an example of the [[Yerk (music)|yerk]] style of music. [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] performed a popular cover version of the classic song.<ref name="Slugthrowers" />

It was played by the Modal Nodes at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] (on the day [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] hired [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]) after playing "[[Mad About Me/Legends|Mad About Me]]."<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
This track was originally named '''"Cantina Band #2"''' on the [[Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope Original Soundtrack|soundtrack]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. No in-universe name was given to it until ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it can be played in [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Jukebox/Legends|jukeboxes]] under the name "Dune Sea Special".
